## 1. Project Title

**Smart PCB Defect Detection & Intelligent Component Identification Using Explainable AI, Digital Twin, and Predictive Manufacturing**

---

# Abstract

Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) are the backbone of every electronic device. Even a small defect such as a missing resistor, solder bridge, misplaced IC, or damaged trace can lead to complete device failure. Most small and medium manufacturing industries still depend on manual inspection or expensive Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems, which either require significant human intervention or produce false alarms.

This project proposes an AI-powered intelligent PCB inspection platform that automatically detects PCB components, identifies manufacturing defects, explains the reason for each detected defect, predicts potential failures, and generates repair recommendations. The system combines state-of-the-art computer vision, deep learning, explainable AI, and a Digital Twin dashboard to provide real-time quality monitoring. The platform also maintains inspection history, defect analytics, and predictive insights for manufacturing optimization.

Unlike existing inspection systems that only identify defects, the proposed system provides interpretable AI explanations, quality scoring, repair guidance, production analytics, and predictive maintenance capabilities, making it suitable for smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 environments.

---

# Problem Statement

PCB manufacturing requires inspection at multiple stages. Existing inspection approaches have several limitations:

* Manual inspection is slow, inconsistent, and error-prone.
* AOI systems are expensive.
* Existing AI models detect defects but do not explain why they occur.
* Most systems cannot predict future production quality.
* Manufacturing managers lack centralized dashboards for quality analysis.
* There is little support for repair recommendations or process improvement.

---

# PHASE 1 – PROJECT PLANNING

# Project Title

**SmartPCB-XAI: An Explainable AI-Based Intelligent PCB Inspection and Manufacturing Analytics Platform for Industry 4.0**

---

# 1. Problem Statement

## Background

Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) are the backbone of modern electronic devices. During PCB manufacturing, defects such as missing components, solder bridges, open circuits, wrong component placement, and damaged traces reduce product quality and increase manufacturing costs.

Most Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) still rely on:

* Manual inspection
* Automated Optical Inspection (AOI)

Manual inspection is slow and inconsistent, while AOI systems are expensive and often produce false alarms. Existing deep learning solutions mainly focus on detecting defects but usually do not explain predictions, recommend repairs, or provide production analytics. ([arXiv][1])

## Problem

There is no integrated intelligent system that combines:

* PCB Component Detection
* PCB Defect Detection
* Explainable AI
* Root Cause Analysis
* Repair Recommendation
* Production Analytics
* Digital Twin Visualization
* Manufacturing Dashboard

within one platform.

---

# 2. Objectives

## Primary Objective

Develop an AI-powered intelligent PCB inspection platform capable of automatically detecting components, identifying defects, explaining AI predictions, recommending repairs, and providing manufacturing analytics.

## Specific Objectives

* Detect PCB components using YOLO.
* Detect manufacturing defects automatically.
* Generate visual explanations using Explainable AI.
* Predict possible manufacturing root causes.
* Suggest repair recommendations.
* Generate inspection reports.
* Visualize inspection results using a Digital Twin.
* Display manufacturing trends through dashboards.
* Build a scalable MERN-based web application.

# Research Gap

Current PCB inspection systems generally:

❌ Detect defects only.

❌ Cannot explain AI predictions.

❌ Do not identify likely manufacturing causes.

❌ Lack production analytics.

# PHASE 2 – DATASET

## Recommended Datasets

### 1. DeepPCB (Defect Detection)

Contains:

* 1,500 aligned PCB image pairs
* Six common defect classes
* Bounding-box annotations ([arXiv][1])

**Project page:** [DeepPCB on Papers With Code](https://paperswithcode.com/dataset/deep-pcb?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

### 2. FICS-PCB (Component Detection)

Contains:

* 9,912 images
* 77,347 component annotations
* Multiple lighting and scale conditions ([PubMed Central (PMC)][4])

**Dataset portal:** [Trust-Hub FICS-PCB Dataset](https://www.trust-hub.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com#/data/fics-pcb)

---

### 3. PCB DSLR Dataset

Contains:

* High-resolution PCB images
* Component annotations ([ScienceDirect][7])

---

### 4. Kaggle PCB Defect Dataset

Includes DeepPCB and enhanced PKU-Market-PCB splits suitable for YOLO training. ([Kaggle][8])

**Download:** [Kaggle PCB Defect Detection Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/liuxiaolong1/pcb-defect-detection-dataset/data?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

# YOLO Label Format

Each `.txt` file contains:

```text
class_id x_center y_center width height
```

Example:

```text
0 0.512 0.438 0.185 0.122
1 0.732 0.584 0.064 0.047
```

Coordinates are normalized between 0 and 1.

# PHASE 3 – AI MODEL

## Model Selection

| Task                  | Model            | Why                                                |
| --------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Component Detection   | YOLOv11          | Fast and accurate object detection                 |
| Defect Detection      | YOLOv11          | Real-time performance and strong benchmark results |
| Explainability        | Grad-CAM         | Visualizes model attention                         |
| Root Cause Prediction | XGBoost          | Effective for structured manufacturing data        |
| Analytics             | Isolation Forest | Detects abnormal production trends                 |

---

## Training Pipeline

```text
Dataset
      │
Image Cleaning
      │
Resize (640×640)
      │
Data Augmentation
      │
YOLO Annotation
      │
Train YOLOv11
      │
Validation
      │
Hyperparameter Tuning
      │
Best Model
      │
Inference API
      │
React Dashboard
```

In the next phase, you would implement:

* YOLOv11 training with Ultralytics,

* FastAPI inference service,
* and MERN integration with the AI model. This will form the core of the intelligent inspection platform.

# 5. ZERO-DETECTION SAFETY

This is extremely important.

Never allow this situation:

```text
Inference failed
↓
components = []
defects = []
↓
quality = 100
↓
PASS
```

That is unacceptable.

Distinguish:

### Genuine clean inspection

```text
inspection_status = SUCCESS
components > 0
defects = 0
quality_score = 100
status = PASS
```

### Suspicious zero detection

```text
inspection_status = SUCCESS
components = 0
defects = 0
suspicious_zero_detection = true
quality_score = null OR clearly flagged
status = REVIEW_REQUIRED
```

### Actual inference failure

```text
inspection_status = ERROR
quality_score = null
components = []
defects = []
```

Display a meaningful frontend warning.

Never present inference failure as a perfect PCB.

| -: | ----------- | ------------- | --------------- | -------------- | -------- |

### STEP 3-4 — Class-mapping honesty audit + model safety layer
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### Real evidence gathered (commands actually run, output actually observed)

Command:
  python -c "from ultralytics import YOLO; m=YOLO('models/component_best.pt'); print(m.names)"
Observed:
  {0:'relay',1:'buzzer',2:'ic',3:'switch',4:'battery',5:'transistor',6:'capacitor',7:'resistor',8:'led',9:'diode'}  -> 10 classes

Command:
  python -c "from ultralytics import YOLO; m=YOLO('models/defect_best.pt'); print(m.names)"
Observed:
  {0:'missing_hole',1:'mouse_bite',2:'open_circuit',3:'short',4:'spur',5:'spurious_copper'}  -> 6 classes

Command:
  cat datasets/components_curated/data.yaml
Observed: 0:ICs 1:capacitors 2:diodes 3:inductors 4:resistors 5:transistors   (6 classes)

Command:
  cat datasets/defects/data.yaml
Observed: 0:open 1:short 2:mousebite 3:spur 4:copper 5:pin-hole   (6 classes, DeepPCB)

Command (byte-level provenance):
  sha256(models/component_best.pt) = 551287ef4f1e2687...
  sha256(models/pcb_component_jd.pt) = 551287ef4f1e2687...   -> IDENTICAL
  sha256(models/defect_best.pt) = 729d660e53406560...
  sha256(models/yolo11_pcb_minhat.pt) = 729d660e53406560...  -> IDENTICAL

#### FINDING 1 (major, honesty): deployed checkpoints are third-party pretrained,
not models trained by this repository.
  - models/component_best.pt  is byte-identical to models/pcb_component_jd.pt  (10-class space)
  - models/defect_best.pt     is byte-identical to models/yolo11_pcb_minhat.pt (PCB-DATASET 6-class space)
  - The repository's OWN trained models are:
      experiments/component_yolo11/weights/best.pt -> {0:'ICs',1:'capacitors',2:'diodes',3:'inductors',4:'resistors',5:'transistors'}
      experiments/defect_yolo11/weights/best.pt    -> {0:'open',1:'short',2:'mousebite',3:'spur',4:'copper',5:'pin-hole'}
    both trained for only 5 epochs on CPU (see experiments/*/args.yaml).
  - Consequence: the shipped system's component class space (10) is NOT the
    curated dataset class space (6), and the shipped defect class space
    (PCB-DATASET names) is NOT the curated DeepPCB class space.

#### FINDING 2 (major, correctness): `led -> capacitors` was a genuine mislabel.
  An earlier alias mapped the model's `led` class onto `capacitors`. That would
  have reported every detected LED as a capacitor. This alias was REMOVED
  2026-09-23 in ai/config.py. `led` is now preserved as an unmapped raw label.
  A regression test now guards this (test_led_is_not_mislabeled_as_capacitor).

#### FINDING 3 (honesty): `missing_hole -> pin-hole` is positional, not semantic.
  DeepPCB `pin-hole` is a pinhole void in copper. PCB-DATASET `missing_hole` is
  an absent/blocked hole. These are different physical phenomena. The mapping is
  applied so the engine runs, but DEFECT_MAPPING_STATUS was downgraded from
  "FULL" to "PARTIAL" and the pair is published under `approximate_mappings`
  in /health. Evidence: datasets/temp_deeppcb/README.md (type 6 = pin-hole)
  vs debug_outputs/DIAGNOSTIC_SUMMARY.json (deployed idx 0 = missing_hole).

#### Files created
  - COMPONENT_CLASS_SCHEMA.md  (new) — authoritative component mapping table,
    ID | Model class | Dataset class | Canonical class | Mapping valid? | Evidence
  - DEFECT_CLASS_SCHEMA.md     (new) — same for defect classes

#### Files modified
  - ai/config.py
      * DEFECT_MAPPING_STATUS "FULL" -> "PARTIAL" (with reason in the docstring)
      * DEFECT_MAPPING_NOTE rewritten to disclose the approximate pair
      * added APPROXIMATE_DEFECT_ALIASES = {"missing_hole": "pin-hole"}
      * (earlier in this pass) COMPONENT_CLASS_ALIASES `led` mislabel removed
  - ai/model_safety.py
      * taxonomy_alignment_report() now emits `approximate_mappings` for both spaces
      * canonical_mapping_status semantics fixed: a checkpoint that shares NO class
        with the expected canonical space now reports FAIL (previously PARTIAL),
        so a genuinely wrong checkpoint can never be reported as partially verified
  - ai_service/main.py
      * /health class_taxonomy now delegates to taxonomy_alignment_report()
        (single source of truth; previously an inline dict missing approximate_mappings)
      * verify_checkpoint() calls now pass alias_map=COMPONENT_CLASS_ALIASES /
        alias_map=DEFECT_CLASS_ALIASES so verification uses the real runtime mapping
  - tests/test_model_safety.py
      * added TestModelSafetyAliasAware (7 tests): valid component PASS, valid defect
        PASS, wrong-checkpoint FAIL under alias map, missing checkpoint BLOCKED,
        corrupt file fails safely without raising, directory path BLOCKED
      * added TestTaxonomyAlignmentReport (3 tests): JSON-serializable + consistent,
        every deployed class has an alias entry, led-is-not-a-capacitor regression guard
  - tests/test_fastapi_health.py
      * test_health_reports_class_taxonomy_mapping_honestly corrected: defect
        mapping_status now asserted PARTIAL with the approximate pair published,
        replacing an assertion that required the inaccurate "FULL"

#### Test result
  BEFORE this pass (session start baseline): 26 tests passing,
    [ModelSafety] component=FAIL defect=FAIL
  AFTER STEP 3-4: 37 tests, "OK" (ran 37 tests in 22.474s), zero failures,
    zero skips, zero errors, and [ModelSafety] component=PASS defect=PASS
  Command: python -m unittest discover -s tests
  No test was weakened or removed to make anything pass; two assertions that

#### Change: backend/server.js — two new read-only routes
  - GET /api/system-status
      Live probe at request time: Express self, mongoose.connection.readyState,
      and a real HTTP GET to FastAPI /health (4s timeout). Returns a JSON object
      with checked_at. Nothing is assumed or hardcoded.
  - GET /api/model-evaluation
      Reads these on-disk artifacts verbatim and returns them with size/mtime:
        reports/benchmark/inference_benchmark.json
        metrics/component_metrics.json            <- DOES NOT EXIST on this machine
        metrics/defect_metrics.json               <- DOES NOT EXIST on this machine
        metrics/per_class_metrics_component.csv   <- DOES NOT EXIST
        metrics/per_class_metrics_defect.csv      <- DOES NOT EXIST
        metrics/full_pipeline_metrics.json        <- EXISTS (23 records)
        metrics/pipeline_20_images_report.csv     <- EXISTS
      Missing artifacts are returned as { available: false, reason: "NOT VERIFIED —
      no evaluation artifact has been generated" }. No fallback value is invented.
  - Verified with: node --check backend/server.js  ->  SYNTAX OK

    mongoose connection state; the inference device now comes from the actual

================================================================================
HOW TO RUN THE PROJECT — added 2026-09-23
================================================================================

PREREQUISITES (verified on this machine: Windows 10, Python 3.13.5,
PyTorch 2.13.0+cpu, Node v24.18.0):
  1. Python deps:      pip install -r requirements.txt
  2. Frontend deps:    cd frontend && npm install
  3. MongoDB running at mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017 (database: smartpcb_xai).
     Start it if not running (e.g. "mongod" or the MongoDB Windows service).
  4. Models present (already in repo): models/component_best.pt,
     models/defect_best.pt
  5. Optional env vars (copy .env.example to backend/.env if you want to
     override; defaults are built in):
       PORT=5000                       (Express)
       FASTAPI_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000
       MONGO_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/smartpcb_xai
       JWT_SECRET=<set a strong secret in production; a dev-only fallback
                   exists and is disclosed in SECURITY_AUDIT.md>

START THE 3 SERVICES (order matters — Express needs MongoDB; FastAPI is
called by Express):
  # Terminal 1 — AI service (FastAPI, port 8000; loads both YOLO models ~20 s):
  python -m uvicorn ai_service.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

  # Terminal 2 — Backend (Express, port 5000, connects to MongoDB):
  cd backend && node server.js

  # Terminal 3 — Frontend (Vite dev server, port 3000):
  cd frontend && npm run dev

OPEN THE APP:
  http://localhost:3000
  The frontend calls same-origin /api/* which Vite proxies to Express:5000,
  so CORS is not an issue in the standard setup.

LOGIN / REGISTER:
  Register from the UI (or API): POST /api/auth/register
    { "username": "...", "email": "...", "password": "...",
      "role": "ENGINEER" | "INSPECTOR", "name": "..." }
  ADMIN cannot self-register (403 by design). Demo login is disabled unless
  ALLOW_DEMO_LOGIN=1.

USE IT:
  Live Inspection page -> upload a PCB image -> detection, severity, XAI,
  quality score, digital twin, analytics, PDF/Excel reports all run from
  that real inspection. Typical CPU latency: ~2-6 s/image (with XAI).

VERIFY IT IS HEALTHY:
  curl http://localhost:5000/api/system-status   (express + mongodb + ai ok)
  curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health              (models loaded, device cpu)

RUN TESTS / EVALUATIONS:
  python -m unittest discover -s tests                (47 tests)
  python scripts/evaluation/evaluate_defect_model.py  (defect mAP metrics)
  python scripts/evaluation/evaluate_full_pipeline.py (23-image pipeline run)
  python scripts/evaluation/validate_20_images.py     (20-image validation)

PRODUCTION BUILD (optional):
  cd frontend && npm run build    (outputs frontend/dist)

STOP: Ctrl+C in each terminal (or stop the three services).
